lines.text: In 1995, a man bought an entire two-hundred-year-old bank
Barings was Queen Elizabeth's personal bank,
and had funded world empires for centuries.
Until a twenty-eight-year-old trader in Singapore
secretly gambled on the Japanese stock market,
and lost over a billion dollars.
The oldest bank in Britain collapsed overnight.
Panicked regulators scrambled for a buyer,
until a Dutch banker offered to take everything,
for the price of a single chocolate bar.
He walked away owning the royal bank
